question: What claim is being made about the scope of the field group by relating it to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: There are all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
A field group belonging to all of them is named.
That field group is described as covering all fields.
inference: The field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs is the all-encompassing field group.
uncertainties: The structural relation between yoginīs and the field group is not specified here.
plain_english: The all-encompassing field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
